events.title: 1.0.1 Demo Patch: gamepad tutorial and bug fixes
events.summary: Hello everyone again, After the demo version was released, several minor issues were discovered: - A freeze during the death animation- The controller not functioning properly in the menu- The gamepad tutorial not working All of these have been fixed in the current version. We'd love to hear your feedback. Hope you enjoy it!
